ui.age_q: Before we begin: are you 13 or older?
ui.spark_q: What does love feel like for you right now?
ui.spark_hint: Pick the one that fits. There's no wrong answer.
ui.echo_intro: Other languages have a word for this:
ui.dataset_title: Here is what people have said so far.
ui.consent_q: Would you like your answer included in this research?
ui.consent_explain: We store the word you chose, your language and the rough region of the world you're in. Nothing else. You can delete it any time.
ui.when_q: When did you last feel this way?
ui.toward_q: Is there someone or something you feel this love toward?
ui.composition_title: Here is the sound of your love.
ui.share_hint: Your link carries only the words and sound you chose. Never your name, never anything you typed.
ui.received_banner: Someone sent you their love, as a sound. Here's theirs. Now make yours.
ui.received_chain: This one has been passed on {n} times.
ui.circle_title: What does love sound like in your circle?
ui.circle_hint: Everyone adds a sound. Nobody sees who chose what, only the chord you make together.
ui.breath_body: You can stop here. Nothing is lost, and nothing was sent unless you said yes.
ui.data_panel: What this page knows about you
ui.framing: A research project of the DAX Foundation
ui.sound_credit: Played in our own voice: harmony only, never a recording.
ui.translate_invite: Speak another language? Help us say this right.
